ja.title: Vepdegestrantは休薬後いつ元の曝露に戻るか
ja.seo_title: Vepdegestrantの休薬・再開PK | Daiki Kumakura
ja.summary: 公開ヒトPopPKモデルで休薬・再開後のAUC、ピーク、投与前濃度を比較。2,048組の条件付き計算を示し、蓄積倍率と第1相試験の要約値との不一致から、予測の未検証部分を整理する。

en.title: Vepdegestrant exposure after interruption and restart
en.summary: A public vepdegestrant PopPK model estimates restart exposure; accumulation discrepancies and unmatched phase 1 summaries limit validation.

en.seo_description: A public vepdegestrant PopPK model estimates restart exposure; accumulation discrepancies and unmatched phase 1 summaries limit validation.

english.title: Vepdegestrant interruption and restart: conditional PK
english.summary: A public oral PK model explores omitted doses and restart with matched prior histories. Accumulation mismatch and covariance ambiguity limit clinical extrapolation.
